crystal_phase: Fluorite-type structure of CeO2 with a face-centered-cubic (FCC) lattice
Proof in the paper: The XRD measurements were conducted using a Philips PW-1800 diffractometer with Cu Kα radiation, and the results are illustrated in Figure 1. All of the diffraction peaks of the x wt % Pt/3DOM CZY samples could be indexed to (111), (200), (220), (311), (222), (400), and (331) lattice planes, and the CZY in x wt % Pt/3DOM CZY possessed a fluorite-type structure of CeO2 with a face-centered-cubic (FCC) lattice.
